evidence.t: About 23 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.
Beside Kahntah River: backwater or oxbow (estimate).
Elevation 496 m: under 900 m, open water later in fall.

seasonRows.notes: District 7. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6.

plan: Drive: from Kahntah, about 51 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 58.00525, -120.89768, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.3 km SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 21 m, about 109 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 120 m E of the spot at 502 m (57.96437, -120.94154). Water: unnamed wetland 90 m NW (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-47, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-16, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BG-duck-backcountry-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-47: about 266 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.03 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
